review_text: I’ve been to Eye Street Café quite a few times, and it’s one of those places I keep going back to mainly for a few of my favourites — especially their chicken omelette and cheese Maggi. Both are absolutely delicious and have always been consistent in taste.  During my recent visit, we decided to try a few different items — red sauce pasta, pink sauce pasta, French toast, and mix noodles. Out of these, the noodles and pink sauce pasta were just okay, nothing special. The French toast, though, was really good — soft, perfectly sweet, and nicely done. Unfortunately, the red sauce pasta was a complete disappointment; it didn’t have much flavour and didn’t taste like a proper red sauce pasta at all. The tea was also not up to the mark — it literally tasted like hot water with sugar, no real tea flavour.  Overall, the experience this time was mixed. Some dishes like the French toast stood out, while others were just average or below expectations. I’d still say Eye Street Café is worth visiting for their chicken omelette and cheese Maggi — those two items never fail. But if you’re planning to try pasta or tea, there’s definitely room for improvement.

review_text: If you are looking for a spot that perfectly balances a laid-back atmosphere with an extensive menu, Ice Treat Cafe (ITC) is a hidden gem. Whether it’s a crisp morning breakfast or a late-evening tea catch-up with friends, this open-air cafe consistently delivers.  The Vibe The open-air setting is the biggest draw. It’s got that breezy, "Food, Friends, Sunshine" energy that makes it ideal for long conversations. It’s a great place to unwind after a long day or start your weekend on a fresh note.  The Food Highlights The English Breakfast: Easily the star of the show. It’s hearty, well-prepared, and offers incredible value for money. It’s definitely "worth every penny" if you’re looking for a satisfying morning meal.  Beverages: Their Tea Varieties are a must-try for evening visits. From a simple Tea with Ginger to a robust Masala Tea, they hit the spot perfectly. For something colder, the Oreo Shake with Vanilla Ice Cream and the Cold Boost are crowd favorites.  Extensive Menu: Looking at the menu, the variety is impressive. They cover everything from Fresh Juices (the Pomegranate and Musambi Solid are great picks) to heavy hitters like Veg Noodles with Chilli Paneer and Egg Fried Rice.  Why We Keep Coming Back What makes ITC special is the consistency. Whether you want a light Lime or a full Chinese Combo, the pricing is extremely pocket-friendly without compromising on the experience. It’s become my go-to "favorite place" for both family outings and hanging out with my friends.  Highly recommended for: Breakfast lovers, tea enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys a relaxed, outdoor dining experience.
